# LogicGuesser

> Daily logic puzzles, brain games, original solving guides, and a short Tech Pulse brief for curious thinkers.

LogicGuesser is a web puzzle platform focused on short, varied reasoning practice. Visitors can play a Daily Challenge, practise puzzle categories, read long-form guides, review puzzle examples, and learn how official puzzles are selected.

## Core pages

- [Home](/): Overview of LogicGuesser, daily puzzles, practice, guides, and player features.
- [Daily Challenge](/daily): Today's five-part puzzle challenge.
- [Practice](/practice): Unlimited practice for logic, word, math, visual, and code puzzles.
- [Puzzle Archive](/puzzle-archive): Sample puzzle categories, explanations, and weekly rotation notes.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Daily, monthly, and yearly puzzle rankings.

## Reading and editorial content

- [Guides](/guides): Original long-form articles about solving techniques, brain training, habits, and puzzle design.
- [Tech Pulse](/news): Daily technology brief for players interested in AI, programming, gaming, hardware, and the web.
- [Editorial Standards](/editorial-standards): How LogicGuesser reviews puzzles, writes guides, handles corrections, and separates ads from editorial content.
- [About](/about): Mission, puzzle categories, and product background.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about accounts, scoring, Pro, submissions, privacy, and languages.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Data collection, cookies, advertising, and privacy rights.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): Account rules, subscriptions, virtual items, and acceptable use.
- [Contact](/contact): Support, privacy, legal, press, and bug-report contact routes.

## Optional

- [Community Puzzles](/community): Player-created puzzles and community submissions.
- [Pro](/pro): Optional ad-free subscription details.
